title: [RTPS] Fix PSK dissection of AES128 encoded messages
description:
The attached captures were previously failing because the length of the computed session key was fixed to 32 bytes, not considering that the length is 16 bytes when using AES128 as the encryption algorithm.

[wireshark_issue_aes128.zip](/uploads/6900780be35ec76d729f16b6ef78df5e/wireshark_issue_aes128.zip)
